title: Probing Signatures of a Distant Planet around the Young T-Tauri Star CI Tau Hosting a Possible Hot Jupiter
question: Does the disk of CI Tau, which hosts a hot Jupiter candidate, show a gap that could be created by a distant planet?

what.value: Dust midplane temperature profile T_d(R)=178±3 (R/1 au)^-0.57±0.02, q=1/2

evidence.quote: the dust temperature at the disk midplane given in (cite: andr07), $T_d(R) = 178\pm3\ (R/1\ {\rm au})^{-0.57\pm0.02}$

recipe.method: CLEAN continuum image, tapered to a circular beam; fit ellipse to 20σ contour with orthogonal distance regression

recipe.goal: Radial surface brightness and brightness temperature profile
recipe.method: Deproject visibilities in uv plane, image, average azimuthally; Planck function for brightness temperature

recipe.goal: Fit gapped disk model to visibilities
recipe.method: Exponentially tapered power-law brightness profile with gap; model image converted to visibilities with vis_sample; MCMC fit to azimuthally averaged deprojected visibilities
key_parameters: 6 free parameters: gamma, R_gap_in, R_gap_out, delta, R_c, F_total; 100 walkers, 1000 iterations, 500 burn-in
assumptions: Optically thin emission, I ∝ T_d τ; q=1/2; fixed i and PA from the image

recipe.method: Empirical gap-opening formulas with aspect ratio 0.122 and alpha=1e-3 or 1e-4

evidence.quote: the gap is located at a deprojected radius of 104.5$\pm$1.6 au
The brightness temperature around the gap was calculated to be $\sim$2.3 K lower than that of the ambient disk.
we find the mass of a planet to be 0.8 $M_{\rm Jupiter}$ and 0.25 $M_{\rm Jupiter}$

not_stated_but_needed: tclean/clean parameters (cell, image size, mask, threshold, niter, uvtaper value)
Which spectral windows were line-free and any channel flagging
MCMC initial walker positions and likelihood form/uncertainties
Dust opacity and aspect-ratio derivation (h/r=0.122) details
Number of azimuthal bins/radial bins in the visibility profile
missing_for_reproduction: MCMC likelihood details and initial conditions
score_reason: Public data and a clear model/MCMC setup, but imaging parameters and likelihood details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, a clear modelling recipe and numeric results (gap radius, width, depth) allow reproduction.
